title: Commentary: A weak South China Sea code of conduct will be worse than no agreement at all
snippet: As Singapore takes over as ASEAN chair in 2027, what remains unresolved on the South China Sea code of conduct are arguably the most intractable issues, says Collin Koh from the S Rajaratnam School of International Studies.

title: India's space startups are going global. Why is that sparking debate at home?
snippet: A satellite startup's US defence expansion has prompted questions over whether its international operations could influence Indian government projects. Experts tell CNA why overseas business matters to the industry and how companies can balance growth with national interests.

title: CNA Explains: What can you recycle in Singapore, and where should it go?
snippet: From cardboard boxes to air conditioners, CNA explains what can be recycled and where. The article is part of Beyond the Bin, a Mediacorp initiative raising awareness on the 3Rs - reduce, reuse and recycle - and more sustainable waste habits in Singapore.

title: A little less power, just as much fun? Driving the new Mini Cooper One in Singapore
snippet: The entry-level Mini Cooper One brings together a three-cylinder engine, sharp steering and compact dimensions. We find out what it’s like to drive on Singapore roads.

title: Trump sees difficulties ahead if Schumer leads Senate
snippet: “It is going to be very hard for me to work with Chuck Schumer should he become Senate Majority Leader,” US President Donald Trump says.
